description: NaHo₂F₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.85 Å. There are two inequivalent Ho sites. In the first Ho site, Ho is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Ho-F bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.41 Å. In the second Ho site, Ho is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Ho-F bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.44 Å. There are seven inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three equivalent Na and one Ho atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Ho tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Ho atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Ho atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ho atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Ho atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Ho atoms. In the seventh F site, F is bonded to three equivalent Na and one Ho atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃Ho tetrahedra.
